topics.topic_label: Vendor governance as a business line (governance stopped being a compliance cost and became a product SKU from three directions in one week - Snowflake and Databricks sell the control plane, Anthropic sells real-time DLP inference hooks for Enterprise, and the first Swiss AI-governance JD read end to end turns out to be a legal role: law degree, CIPP/E-CIPM-AIGP, German and English, and not one technical requirement)

Implementation & services revenue (the last-mile thesis gets a matching JD - Orange Business puts 'advising C-level stakeholders on AI strategy, governance, and roadmaps' inside an engineering role, which is the same claim a French practitioner tribune makes from the other side: raw model capability has become a commodity and the contest is decided after the demo; SAP's proof point is a customer cutting HR cycle times 40-60%)

Vendor governance as a product line (ServiceNow's AI Control Tower hits GA covering discover/observe/govern/secure/measure with an MCP gateway in front of all customer MCP transactions, Traceloop-derived runtime agent observability, five NIST- and EU-AI-Act-mapped risk frameworks and a Veza real-time kill switch; Mistral open-sources Shieldstral, a 3B Apache-2.0 guard model re-policied by natural-language question at inference time; Salesforce clears DoD IL5 — governance became a product SKU the same month it became a fine)

Implementation & deployment revenue (OpenAI opens a second, more senior Zürich deployment seat — Technical Deployment Lead alongside the existing Forward Deployed Engineer — suggesting the function is being built out rather than filled as a one-off; the enterprise-side counterpart is a five-stage agentic adoption maturity model that attributes the deployment gap to operating maturity rather than model quality)

Sovereign AI infrastructure (the Swiss public sector enters the hiring file at all three tiers of government in one pass — MeteoSchweiz federal, Kanton Luzern advertising a named 'KI-Plattform-Spezialist', Stadt Bern municipal, plus USZ, ZHdK, ZHAW and HES-SO — nine public reqs from zero in the file's entire prior history, invisible until now because they are posted in German and French as 'KI'; Swisscom launches an in-country Swiss AI Platform; Infomaniak and Omnilex hire for sovereign-cloud and data-residency runtimes)

Sovereign & non-US AI infrastructure (L&T's ~$1.57B 10,000-B300 Chennai cluster for Together AI, Naver funding wave-powered offshore compute, Microsoft down to ~1.5% of worldwide revenue in China, Apertus and Swisscom)
